svg.text: Euclid in Codillon's Editor: Stack Fractions Preserve Div(x) ∩ Div(y) to Seat 4
Left gutter: 1:1 refined stack fractions (84×14 px) with pale-lavender dataflow ribbons. Right panel: step-by-step trace for (a=12, b=8).
Every step replaces (x, y) with (y, x mod y) while
Why y = 0 Unlocks the Return Cup:
• Every d ∈ ℕ divides 0 (0 = 0 · d), so Div(0) = ℕ.
• At br_if $exit: Div(x) = Div(x) ∩ ℕ = Div(a) ∩ Div(b).
• Thus x = 4 satisfies Div(x) = Div(12) ∩ Div(8),
and seats cleanly in the Gcd(12, 8) socket!
